adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the variable `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed using `&&` between `isTeamAdmin(...)` and `isTeamOwner(...)`, meaning the user must be both an admin and an owner to pass that branch. This contradicts the variable name and the likely intended permission model (admin OR owner). As written, a team admin who is not also an owner will fail `isTeamAdminOrOwner` and can be blocked by the subsequent `FORBIDDEN` check unless they are also the organizer or an attendee.
